title: get_model_relations fails when parameters are set with lambda functions
author: mochar

comments.author: tillahoffmann
comments.body:
[`param`](https://num.pyro.ai/en/stable/primitives.html#numpyro.primitives.param) expects the second argument to be `init_value`, i.e., a literal value instead of a callable that returns a value.

Does this work for you?

```python
numpyro.param('p', 1.)
```

comments.author: mochar
comments.body: That works. However `param` can also be supplied a callable that recieves a jax key, which I use to initialize my parameters. See https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/ddbd0b876d3cf07d457683d520f00c85f0cc0bb8/numpyro/primitives.py#L252

comments.author: tillahoffmann
comments.body: Yes, apologies. Looks like we may need further exceptions in how the trace elements are handled.
